tools.name: browser_identities
tools.description: List every identity in the server-hosted fleet with its live state and whether the local tunnel/port is up.

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: One identity's authoritative record from the fleet host plus its local loopback CDP probe.

tools.name: browser_ensure
tools.description: Warm an identity: remote `browser-fleetctl ensure` + loopback tunnel + health check. Idempotent.

host.description: Only 'remote' is accepted; local Chrome is refused.

bootstrap.description: Requesting true returns an operator proposal, never an execution.

tools.name: browser_attach
tools.description: Return the identity's loopback CDP handle (ws URL, HTTP base, live page targets) for the caller to drive directly.

tools.name: browser_run
tools.description: Bounded scripted action on a warm identity: navigate and/or eval, returns {url,title,text,results}. Refuses stealth domains and unknown identities.

url.description: Shortcut for a first goto step.

tools.name: browser_stop
tools.description: Explicit-only stop: drop the tunnel and stop the remote unit. Requires confirm=true.
